Ana: Heads up — I'm shifting the midnight triage to 23:45 PST tonight. Quick reasons: two deploys finishing at 23:15 and need 30m buffer. @Jordan can you confirm you'll be on the bridge?
Jordan: Yep I'm available. I'll join the bridge at 23:40. Can we move the runbook checklist to the top of agenda?
Sam: +1 for checklist. Also flagging the netcache incident (INC-452) is still in progress, brief below.
Maria: I'm on INC-452 patching a regression in shard sync. ETA 45m. I'll post logs when I restart the worker.
Jordan: Thanks — we'll prioritize that first in triage. @Liz can you cover escalation point if it goes to SRE?
Liz: I can. If Maria needs escalation, DM me and I'll page infra on call.
Ana: Agenda for tonight's passoff: 1) Quick deploy status, 2) INC-452 status + logs, 3) Queue backlog sweep (high-latency requests), 4) Canary health check and rollback plan. Keep updates short.
Sam: For the queue sweep — I'll prepare the top-10 latency queries and a quick SQL snippet: ```SELECT path, count(*) FROM request_logs WHERE latency_ms > 2000 GROUP BY path ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT 10;```
Maria: Posted restart logs: https://internal-logs/restarts/452 (this link), error was OOM on worker-4 before restart. Restart cleared cache but memory trending up.
Jordan: If memory climbs post-restart, escalate to infra. Suggested immediate mitigations: reduce batch_size from 64 -> 32 on worker config: `BATCH_SIZE=32` and enable prefix cache TTL=60s.
Ana: OK action items: Maria to monitor memory + post metrics, Sam to run queue query before call, Jordan to prepare bridge and rollback steps, Liz to be escalation contact. We'll run a quick 15m sync and then do async updates in thread.
incident-bot: Reminder — scheduled triage bridge created: https://meet/triage/2018512345 (scheduled for 23:45 PST). Host: Ana. :bell:
Jordan: One more — CR ping: PR #3124 needs a quick review; if anyone's free please take a look before the triage so we don't pile up reviews.
Sam: I can take a look after I finish the queue query, ping me in thread when PR is ready.
Ana: Great. If anything changes, update this thread. I'll start the bridge at 23:40 and post handoff notes after the sync. :thumbsup:
